text:
The Outer Worlds 2: Side Effects Guaranteed Announce Trailer
Side Effects Guaranteed is the first chapter of a two-part expansion for The Outer Worlds 2. A distress signal beckons you and your crew of the Incognito to a derelict ship, where you discover the ship’s crew in suspended animation—infected with something that causes explosive cell death. The hunt for a cure leads to Elysium Valley, a brand-new region on Eden.
 
Two Sub Rosa agents have very different plans for it, and the fate of the valley, the crew, and Sub Rosa itself is yours to decide. (Side effects may vary.)

Side Effects Guaranteed DLC releases on December 2. Get it for $14.99, or with the Premium Edition or Premium Edition Upgrade for The Outer Worlds 2.

A dream summer in Japan awaits - it’s time to help Pon rebuild the shrine! TANUKI: Pon’s Summer is OUT NOW!

text:
Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories – Story Trailer
Digital pre-orders and physical edition pre-orders are now available.

This entry in the Atelier series focuses on tying in alchemy to deepen every aspect of the game. Synthesized items can now be used for more than just combat. They will assist you during exploration and base-building, and will help shape the very path of your adventure. Karia can also eat synthesized items to change both her appearance and abilities. Synthesize items, use them on your adventure, and eat them. This cycle will tie everything together in this new evolution of the Atelier series.

The Spotter: Dig or Die - Official Date Announcement Trailer | XBOX Series X|S
Dig by day. Defend by night. Survive at all costs!

https://www.xbox.com/games/store/the-spotter-dig-or-die/9n3cr0sq9w9g\n\n

Welcome to the worst gas station in Nevada, where mutant hordes are knocking at your door and the fate of the world might just depend on you!

Dig deep underground to uncover valuable resources, upgrade your equipment, and transform your rusty outpost into an unstoppable fortress. But don’t get too comfortable! When night falls, hordes of mutants come crawling out of the wasteland, and it’s up to you to hold the line.

Build deadly defenses, unlock powerful weapons, discover game-changing roguelike artifacts, and take control of your turrets to fight back against the chaos.

And remember, you’re not just fighting to survive. You’ve got a broken receiver to repair and a very important message from the President to catch!
